title: Total time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly calculated and stated as 12.28 s (or equivalent).

title: Optimal speed determination
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must correctly identify the adjusted speed as 4 m/s.

title: Acceleration phase analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the acceleration on the conveyor belt (a = μ₁g = 1 m/s²) and the time/distance to reach belt speed.

title: Turntable speed limit
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion to find the maximum safe speed on the turntable (μ₂g = v²/R).

title: Kinematics on conveyor
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly segment the motion on the belt into accelerated and constant-speed phases, using L=10 m.

title: Time on turntable
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the time on the turntable using the arc length (πR) and the linear speed.

title: Comparison of limiting speeds
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may discuss comparing the belt's maximum achievable speed (√(2μ₁gL)) with the turntable's maximum safe speed to justify the optimal speed.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize incorrect unit handling (e.g., forgetting g=10 m/s²) or sign errors in kinematic equations.

title: Slipping condition confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize confusing static and kinetic friction for the turntable or misapplying the centripetal force condition (using μ₁ instead of μ₂).
